Static controls; never execute the scripts. Copy controls outside testdata before scanning to exercise normal rules. The scriptlet variants derive from the byte-verified ZipLine excerpt already in testdata/triage/python-pipe-com-review. Node variants derive from the synthetic strconf-dropper fixture; its shortened URL paths are invented. The small PowMix control tests preservation of the existing marker-plus-placeholder composite, not a claim to be an original malware artifact. Original PowMix loader hash recovery was attempted with forager and was unavailable from configured sources.

Run check.py against cleave JSONL for these controls. The batch review.json also records all original scans, native disassembly, missing-leg tests, and residual decoder/classifier gaps. The full loader missing-transform control and retained earlier regression controls are in the scratch evidence directory named in that report.
